usage: SwiftUI view ports of the best patterns. Self-contained files with #Preview.

swiftui_views.title: Gig Calendar
swiftui_views.description: Gig-poster month grid with orange stamps marking show dates and venues.

swiftui_views.title: Chat Thread
swiftui_views.description: Surf-shop chat thread with ticket-stripe message bubbles, reply row, and input bar.

swiftui_views.title: CtaDeploy
swiftui_views.description: Industrial deploy CTA: typed command line, big condensed headline, and rotated rubber-stamp button.

swiftui_views.title: Quiet Empty State
swiftui_views.description: Restrained scandi empty state: one muted symbol, calm serif, honest copy, single text button.

swiftui_views.title: FeaturesBento
swiftui_views.description: Asymmetric Memphis bento: large tile, wide tile, rotated sticker card, and squiggle divider.

swiftui_views.title: HeroEditorial
swiftui_views.description: Broadsheet editorial hero with oversized drop-cap lede, hairline rules, and small-caps kicker.

swiftui_views.title: HeroVaporwave
swiftui_views.description: Synthwave station hero with slitted sun disc, perspective grid floor, and chrome headline.

swiftui_views.title: Blueprint Kanban
swiftui_views.description: Blueprint kanban column with annotated spec-sheet cards, dimension lines, and amber flags.

swiftui_views.title: Deco Login
swiftui_views.description: Art-deco split login with a gold fan divider, hairline fields, and a monogram mark.

swiftui_views.title: Onboarding Wizard
swiftui_views.description: Warm 3-step cottage onboarding with a stitched dashed progress path and numbered knots.

swiftui_views.title: PricingHonest
swiftui_views.description: Brutal hairline-grid pricing table with an exclusion matrix row and fine-print strip.

swiftui_views.title: Settings Page
swiftui_views.description: Spec-sheet settings with hairline rows, working controls, and mono microcaps section labels.

swiftui_views.title: StatsTerminal
swiftui_views.description: Terminal readout of stats: mono rows, amber highlights, and a blinking cursor block.

swiftui_views.title: TestimonialWall
swiftui_views.description: Offset masonry of record-sleeve quote cards with varying heights, sleeve rotation, and Side A/B toggle.
